## Goal (one sentence)

## Questions (answer briefly)
1) Scope in/out? Any explicit non-goals?
2) Acceptance Criteria (AC)?
3) Constraints (performance, security, cost, deadline)?
4) Environment/data/source dependencies?
5) Risks/unknowns?
6) Definition of Done (DoD) ok?
7) Who approves? By when?

## Notes / Proposed short plan
Bullets 3–7 steps for review (will use update_plan if approved).
